title: A note on right-angled Artin subgroups of one-relator groups
summary: We give a short proof of the following result due to Howie: if $A(Γ)$ is a right-angled Artin group embedding into some one-relator group, then $Γ$ is a finite forest. The proof only uses elementary Bass--Serre theory and classical properties of one-relator groups.
